translations.graph.aireExplication: One area per consultation: orange for current rations, blue for proposed ones. Σ: mean weighted by the coefficients. For nutrients, select two axes to see the area.
translations.admin.activerMultirationAide: Shows the multi-ration exploration button in the animal list.
translations.multiration.referentielsAide: Each reference is combined with every weight: no physiological profile is inferred from the weight.
translations.multiration.aucunReferentiel: No general reference for this species.
translations.multiration.besoinTotalAide: Total energy requirement = standard requirement × K (saved as the adjustment coefficient when a ration is opened). Thresholds per 1000 kcal remain based on the standard requirement, as in the ration analysis.
translations.multiration.combinaisonAide: One combination = one food from each list. Successive adjustments in this order; energy is completed last.
translations.multiration.celluloseAide: For crude fibre, the adjustment aims at 5 × the threshold, like the multi-nutrient adjustment. Compliance is still assessed against the reference's thresholds.
translations.multiration.energieAide: Amount calculated last to complete the energy. An energy excess is flagged, never a negative amount.
translations.multiration.selAide: Rounded to a tenth of a gram, except for packaged units. The amount covers what is still missing after the previous ingredients.
translations.multiration.pasManuelAide: The manual step replaces the 1 / 5 / 25 g rules; a packaged unit still takes priority. 0 = automatic rules.
translations.multiration.ajouterListe: Add an ingredient list (EPA/DHA, other nutrient)
translations.multiration.cliquerAjoute: Clicking a food adds it to the list (%1$s selected).
translations.multiration.arrondiAide: Rounded after each adjustment: ½ unit (pod, sachet, can), otherwise 0.1 g for salt and additional lists; for the other lists, 1 g below 20 g, 5 g below 200 g, 25 g above.
translations.multiration.arrondiSupAide: Any positive amount reaches at least the minimum dose. An energy excess caused by rounding is accepted up to one step of the energy food.
translations.multiration.arrondiProcheAide: Below the minimum dose, a food is left out (under half) or raised to that dose. Energy is accepted within ± ½ step of the energy food.
translations.multiration.ignorerOptimax: Ignore OPTIMAX: only MAX limits intakes
translations.multiration.valeursAbsentesAide: Missing values of a food count as 0, as in the ration analysis. A scenario that only fails on nutrients with no data is “compliant with reservations”.
translations.multiration.besoinsAide: Untick a nutrient to ignore all its thresholds and its adjustment. Its ingredient list becomes optional. Energy is always taken into account.
translations.multiration.enregistrerAide: Saved: species, references, weight × K grids, ingredient lists, targets and options. Results are recalculated after loading.
translations.multiration.supprimerTexte: “%1$s” will be deleted. Consultations already opened from this exploration are kept.
translations.multiration.introResultats: Choose the references, the grid and the ingredient lists on the left, then “Calculate all rations”. Clicking a cell of the map shows its rations; they can then be opened in the ration analysis to be analysed, edited and exported.
translations.multiration.parametresModifies: Settings changed since the last calculation: the results shown do not include them yet.
translations.multiration.besoinsIgnores: Ignored requirements: %1$s. Compliance only covers the requirements kept.
translations.multiration.bilanScenarios: %1$s scenarios; %2$s compliant with the thresholds kept that have data (unknown values included).
translations.multiration.cliquerCase: Click a cell to see its rations. Label: n/N combinations compliant with the thresholds that have data; unknown values are still flagged in the detail.
translations.multiration.equilibrableAide: A cell can be balanced if at least one combination meets every threshold. The adjustment is sequential: a red cell means that no combination tested works with this method, not that no ration exists.
translations.multiration.legendeSousReserve: Can be balanced with unknown data
translations.multiration.detailCase: %1$s — %2$s/%3$s combinations compliant with the thresholds that have data
translations.multiration.ouvrirAide: The rations open in a standalone view with the cell's reference, weight and K. Corrections can be saved in the exploration; no animal or consultation is created.
translations.multiration.zone.SOUS_RESERVE: With reservations: only nutrients with no data fail
translations.multiration.zone.SEUILS_NON_RESPECTES: Cannot be balanced: thresholds with data not met
translations.multiration.zone.ENERGIE_DEPASSEE: Cannot be balanced: energy already exceeded
translations.multiration.zone.NON_EVALUABLE: Cannot be assessed (target or composition missing)
translations.multiration.courbes.aide: The curves use the scenarios of the last calculation. Scenarios that cannot be calculated or have no target are left as gaps.
translations.multiration.courbes.nutrimentsAide: Up to four nutrients. Incomplete intakes are left as gaps; thresholds use the standard BEE, as in the analysis. Ratios are calculated on the whole ration.
translations.multiration.courbes.aucuneDonnee: No data can be calculated for this selection.
translations.copieRation.titre: Reuse a ration from another consultation
translations.copieRation.aide: The foods and their amounts will be added to a new proposed ration. You can then edit them.
translations.copieRation.aucune: No ration available in this animal's other consultations.
translations.copieRation.reprise: Ration added to the current consultation
translations.explorationRations.enregistrerAide: Save your corrections to update the exploration's tables, map and curves.
translations.explorationRations.besoins: Standard requirement: %1$s kcal; adjusted requirement: %2$s kcal
